_read: Ships' option effects, read from the book. audit_effects.py produces a check queue of the options whose text promises a profile change but which have no structured effect; this file is where the decision is recorded. An acknowledged row leaves the queue.
_rule: An acknowledgement without a page number is not valid. The effect is implemented in build_data.py's OPT_EFFECTS table - it is the only place where an effect may be born. Do not infer an effect from the text at run time.

_keys.ship: the ship's name exactly as in bfg_data.json
_keys.text: the option's text (the start is enough, matching is done to 120 characters)
_keys.page: the book's page the decision was read from
_keys.effect: a structured effect, or null if the option does NOT change the profile
_keys.why: in one sentence: what the page says and what follows from it
_keys.verified: true only when the page has really been read

_example.text: May purchase a third turret for an additional +10 points.
_example.why: The book: a third turret +10 pts. The base value is 2, so the change is +1 and not setting 3 - an addition survives a change in the data better.

_example_no_effect.text: If the torpedo refit is taken, the ship does not have to be modified
_example_no_effect.why: The sentence concerns building the miniature, not the game profile. Not modelled.

options.text: May purchase a third turret for an additional +10 points.

options.text: May have a third shield for +15 pts

options.text: May be equipped with boarding torpedoes for +5 pts
options.why: Rulebook p.78: 'Boarding torpedoes are launched like ordinary torpedoes' - the option gives the ship's own torpedo tubes a second ammunition, not a new weapon row (the user 12.10.2026, J190: a boarding torpedo purchase goes only on the option row, not into the weapons). The speed and strength are in the option's text. The earlier record: The book p.374: '(speed 20 cm; strength D6+2)'. The option carries its own profile; the row is on the card only when chosen. The arc is the prow tubes' (Front). The prow launchas are always on the ship (p.374 "In each turn, these launchas can either fire torpedoes or be used as a bombardment cannon"), so the option does not depend on the prow choice. Implemented in OPT_EFFECTS add (P1-3).

options.text: Ion Cannon Turret +15 pts
options.why: The book p.480, the security module's defence systems: 'Ion Cannon Turret +15 pts'. The station is entirely choices: every base row is option-owned (aws, group 480_defence, gmax 1) and ticked when it is bought. The first version added an add row, which doubled the turret - the driver caught it (5 rows, 0 in force). No new code.

options.text: The Omnissiah’s Victory represents only one of several unique Arks Mechanicus
options.why: The book p.126: 'an Ark Mechanicus may exchange its broadside lance batteries for strength-2 launch bays for +10 points.' The broadside lances (rows 2-3) are replaced by launch bays; the attack craft are Fury/Starhawk (p.125, no assault boats), speeds per the Imperial profiles 30/20 cm. Implemented in OPT_EFFECTS sw (item 7, batch 6).

options.text: Can replace its Firepower 10 weapons batteries with Firepower 4 weapons batteries and Strength 2 lance batteries
options.why: The book p.279: '(all 45 cm range, with port and starboard arcs each) for no extra points'. Batteries 45 cm/10 -> 45 cm/4 (swp) and two lance rows more (an add list). Implemented in OPT_EFFECTS (item 7, batch 7).

options.text: Squadrons can carry experimental long range detection gear.
options.why: The book p.84: 'doubles the Leadership test bonus for enemy contacts ... from +1 to +2 but removes the squadron's weapons batteries'. The batteries go (del); the Ld bonus is a game rule, which prints as the option text. The restrictions (more than half Cobras, all take it, only Imperial) are list rules. Implemented in OPT_EFFECTS del (item 7, batch 7).

options.text: Prow — torpedo launcha instead of heavy gunz
options.why: The book p.383: 'For no change in cost, they may exchange their prow heavy gunz for a torpedo launcha (Speed 30 cm, Strength D6) or additional D6 gunz (for D6+2 in total).' One sentence, two exclusive swaps - split into two options (group lite_prow, gmax 1) in build_data.py. This is the first: the launcha replaces the prow heavy gunz (row 3).

options.text: Prow — additional D6 gunz
options.why: The book p.383, the same sentence's second alternative: the prow heavy gunz 4 -> D6+2 'in total'. Exclusive with the launcha (lite_prow).

options.text: Xenotech system (free, choose one) — Long Range Sensors
options.why: The book p.175/184: '+1 to its base leadership (max. of Ld 10)'. Leadership is not a stat on the ship card (rolled at the start of the game); the option's text prints on the card. The audit's 'range' hit is from the words 'Long Range'.

options.text: Xenotech system (free, choose one) — Advanced Shielding
options.why: The book p.175: 'increases the strength of its shields by +1'. Implemented in build_data.py's p.184 block (mod sh +1); the audit's 'strength' hit means the shield, not a weapon.

options.text: Xenotech system (free, choose one) — Ship Defense Grid
options.why: The book p.175: 'increases the strength of its turrets by +1'. Implemented (mod tu +1); the audit's 'strength' hit means the turrets.
